title: A Practical Framework for Evaluating Medical AI Security: Reproducible Assessment of Jailbreaking and Privacy Vulnerabilities Across Clinical Specialties
reasoning: The paper focuses on technical security vulnerabilities such as adversarial jailbreaking and privacy extraction attacks in medical AI. It does not contain a component evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics; its primary concern is safety through the lens of adversarial robustness and data privacy.
